title: On Ricci solitons whose level hypersurfaces have parallel second fundamental form
authors: Matheus Andrade Ribeiro de Moura Horácio
summary: We study gradient Ricci solitons whose potential functions have level hypersurfaces with parallel second fundamental form. We show that such a soliton is locally a multiply warped product of a one-dimensional base and Einstein fibers, with potential function depending only on the base. Thus, locally, this condition characterizes the multiply warped structure that occurs in many classical constructions of Ricci solitons.
